description:
Is your iPhone storage full again? Cleaner Guru helps you free up iPhone storage in seconds — all in one app.

- Delete duplicate photos instantly
- Compress videos with minimal quality loss
- Bulk delete spam emails
- Auto-merge duplicate contacts
- Free up storage in a few taps

» DUPLICATE PHOTO CLEANER
Your gallery looks like a mess and it's hard to find the photos that matter? Cleaner Guru's AI scans your entire library, finds every duplicate and similar photo, marks the best shot, and lets you delete the rest in one tap. Clean camera roll, found in seconds.

» EMAIL CLEANER – STOP INBOX SPAM FOR GOOD
Thousands of unread emails and spam subscriptions draining your focus? Delete all emails on iPhone at once, unsubscribe from spam lists with a single tap, and keep your inbox clean for good. Works with Gmail.

» VIDEO COMPRESSOR APP FOR IPHONE
Don't want to delete precious videos but running out of space? Compress videos on iPhone with minimal quality loss — reduce file sizes significantly and free up gigabytes instantly. Keep every memory without sacrificing storage.

» CONTACTS CLEANUP – MERGE DUPLICATES INSTANTLY
Duplicate and unnamed contacts making your address book a mess? Cleaner Guru finds and merges duplicate contacts on iPhone automatically — save time finding the right person and keep your contact list clean and organized.

» SECRET FOLDER – PRIVATE & SECURE
Keep sensitive photos and videos in a password-protected vault. Your personal content stays on your device — we never upload your files to external servers.

OFFLINE & 100% PRIVATE
Cleaner Guru works completely offline. All processing happens locally on your device — your photos, videos, and contacts never leave your iPhone. No tracking. No uploads. Your privacy is fully protected.

REVIEW BEFORE YOU DELETE
You are always in control. Preview every file before it's removed — nothing is deleted without your explicit approval. No accidental deletions, ever.

Stop juggling storage warnings and start actually using your iPhone. Cleaner Guru — free up space, clean up clutter, and get back to what matters. Download now and see the difference in minutes.

SUBSCRIPTION INFORMATION

Payment: Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
Renewal Charges: Based on the selected plan, your account will be charged for renewal 24 hours before the end of the current period.
